listening.title: What you listen to

listening.historyNeedsGoogle: Link your Google account to use it.
listening.public: Show what I listen to publicly

listening.widgetAlt: What I am listening to on Lyra

listening.recentFriends: Show my friends what I played

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices

tokens.title: Personal tokens
tokens.body: Let other apps (a Discord plugin, a script) see what you are listening to. Treat them like a password.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.createdOnce: Copy your token now: you will not see it again.
tokens.events: To hear about every change right away, without asking every few seconds, connect to {{path}} (Server-Sent Events).

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Deletes your Lyra account, sessions, passkeys and Google link, plus the downloads on this device. Your YT Music library is not touched.
delete.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

about.title: About Lyra
about.available: A new version is out: {{version}}, published on {{date}}.
about.what: Lyra is not a standalone player: it is a YouTube Music client. It uses your account and the YT Music catalog just like the official web app, and adds what that app lacks: crossfade, an equalizer, synced lyrics, offline downloads and control from your other devices.
about.unofficial: Unofficial project, not affiliated with Google or YouTube. It may stop working whenever YouTube changes its API.
about.data: Lyra is self-hosted: your account, your settings and your Google session (encrypted) are stored on the server of whoever runs this instance. Your music, library and history are still those of your YouTube Music account.
about.repo: Open source under the MIT license

motion.title: Animations
motion.hint: Transitions between pages and when windows open. “System” follows your device's reduce-motion setting.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: We let you know when someone sends you a friend request, accepts yours or invites you to a playlist. Turn it on separately on each device.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, first add Lyra to the home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
notifications.denied: You blocked notifications from Lyra. To turn them on, allow them in your browser’s site settings.
notifications.failed: Notifications could not be turned on. Try again.

settings.title: Audio settings
settings.autoplay: Keep playing similar songs when the queue ends
settings.dataSaverHint: Uses these qualities on mobile data or with the browser's data saver.
settings.onMobileData: You are on mobile data now.
settings.normalizationHint: Uses YouTube's measure so no song sounds much louder or quieter than another.
settings.limiterHint: A limiter lowers only the peaks that would distort the sound.
settings.boostWarning: Listening at high volume for a long time can damage your hearing, and small speakers can distort or get damaged. Turn it up gradually.
settings.boostWarningNoLimiter: With "Prevent distortion" off, the sound will break up.

googleRequired.title: Link your Google account
googleRequired.notLinked: This server can only play songs with a linked Google account, because YouTube blocks anonymous requests coming from it. Link it from your profile: Lyra keeps only the session.

fallbackStatus.ready: Ready: the account exists and has Google linked.
fallbackStatus.unknown_user: There is no user with that name.
